main.description: Upload one part. Parts are idempotent and may be retried or re-sent while the session is created. Each expected length is derived from the upload size and part size, and Content-Length must match exactly. ETags are never exposed to clients.

errors.description: The job ID is unknown or aged out of retention; known terminal sessions are never reported as not found.
errors.name: UploadNotFound

errors.description: The upload session expired before completion.
errors.name: UploadExpired

errors.description: The part number is outside the upload's valid part range.
errors.name: InvalidPartNumber

errors.description: Content-Length does not exactly match the expected size for this part.
errors.name: PartSizeMismatch

errors.description: A finish is in progress; check getUploadStatus and retry.
errors.name: UploadNotReady

errors.description: The session is known to have failed; the error carries its failure reason.
errors.name: UploadFailed

errors.description: The session is known to have been aborted.
errors.name: UploadAborted

errors.description: The session is known to have already completed.
errors.name: UploadAlreadyCompleted

errors.description: The service is draining or temporarily at capacity; retry on another worker.
errors.name: ServiceOverloaded
